entry.title: Oregon Fire Officials Warn of Increased Carbon Monoxide Risk During Colder Months
entry.summary: With 62% of Oregon's carbon monoxide emergencies occurring during fall and winter, the Oregon State Fire Marshal is urging residents to check heating equipment, test alarms, and take steps to prevent potentially deadly exposure.

entry.title: Oregon Department Of Forestry To Host Live Air Curtain Incinerator Demonstration In Roseburg November 20

entry.title: Douglas County Ballot Returns Near 50% As Election Day Approaches
entry.summary: Douglas County has received 44,518 ballots for the November 3 general election, bringing participation to 49.77%. Voters have until 8 p.m. Tuesday to use an official drop site. Mailed ballots must be postmarked by Election Day.

entry.title: Morning Fog, Mild Temperatures and Limited Rain Chances Expected in Roseburg This Week
entry.summary: Roseburg will see morning fog, mostly cloudy skies and mild temperatures this week, with highs ranging from 60 to 67 degrees. Rain chances remain limited, although forecasters are watching for wetter weather during the second week of November.

entry.title: YMCA of Douglas County Opens Youth Basketball Registration November 2

entry.title: Pass Creek Covered Bridge in Drain Added to National Register of Historic Places
entry.summary: The Pass Creek Covered Bridge in Drain has been added to the National Register of Historic Places. Built in 1925, the bridge is recognized for its engineering significance and is among fewer than 50 historic covered bridges remaining in Oregon.
